integrity: An analytic all-prime Gauss-sum derivation and elementary interval-character proof establish the claim. A standalone standard-library direct-correlation and Fourier-fourth-moment checker corroborates finite cases but does not prove the asymptotic. An older related partial-period paper was not accessible in full and remains a bibliographic-priority risk.
limitations: Odd prime cyclic lengths, standard quadratic chirps, exactly two fully erased symbols and unnormalized integrated squared cyclic sidelobes; not a general optimal phase-code or peak-sidelobe result. No finite-prime closed-form optimizer classification is asserted.
title: A sharp prime-class law for two-deletion quadratic chirp sidelobe energy
